title: Раскаяние Насти и наряд полиции  (Nastya's Remorse and the Police Raid)

segments.t: With everyone gathered in the office, Nastya tearfully confesses to her father and Kostya that she staged her own kidnapping because her homeless friends desperately needed money. Just as she begs their forgiveness, a squad of police officers called by her mother raids the kitchen.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'What the Chef did not know.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'who' and finishing on 'knew'.
'Was that I bought them myself.' Notice how Russian expresses 'then' and 'bought' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'They needed the money very badly.' In Russian, the idea of 'it' flows naturally into 'money' without extra filler words.
'Could you not simply have asked me for it?' Max brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'to ask' in a few short words.
'You could have at least warned me.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'could' and finishing on 'to warn'. Kostya answers right away.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
'I thought we trusted each other.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'other' in spoken Russian.
'Kostik, please forgive me.' Max anchors the line on 'Kostik', while 'sorry' completes the thought.
'Dad, forgive me.' In Russian, the idea of 'Dad' flows naturally into 'sorry' without extra filler words. Kostya answers right away.
'Forgive me, all of you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'forgive' before landing on 'me'.
'The restrooms and locker rooms are clear.' The grammar packs 'toilet' and 'clean' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Go check the storage room.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'storage' and finishing on 'check'. Kostya answers right away.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?
'Officer, I do not understand, where did you guys come from?' In Russian, the idea of 'commander' flows naturally into 'to appear' without extra filler words.
'I was the one who called them.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'called'. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?
